title: AI Agent Benchmark: Score Every Prompt Change
description:
Did your last prompt tweak actually help your AI agent? 📊

✅ Loop a claude -p run over a folder of tasks
✅ Count the checks that pass with a tiny bash script
✅ Turn every harness change into a score like 4/5

Day 10 of Agent Harness, the last one in the series. Next up: the new series Build AI Apps, Day 1: Call an LLM API from the Terminal.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

#shorts #aitools #aicoding #aiagents #claudecode #coding #programming
comment: Benchmark or manual testing: which would you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep each task small with its own check.sh, so a pass or fail is clear and the score is easy to compare.
